result.title: Attending to Memory Writes Reduces Seed Variability in Recurrent Length Generalization
result.summary: Recurrent memory requires learning useful updates, but attention added to assist learning can also compromise length generalization. We study bounded delta attention: causal attention over uncorrected update proposals whose bounded correction enters the recurrent update. Its implementation in TraceRelay combines additive phase recurrence with attention computed before a parallel scan. On prefix-supervised modulo-5, trained at lengths 1--40, three findings characterize its behavior at length 80. First, upper delta attention attains $70.81\pm8.26$% accuracy across seven seeds, versus $69.21\pm22.42$% for the local-attention recurrent baseline (mean $\pm$ sample SD): a 63.2% reduction in SD with a similar mean. Upper state attention also reduces variation, reaching $74.75\pm6.24$%, so this benefit is not unique to update-level attention. Disabling the upper delta correction retains $70.62\pm8.60$%. Second, blocking gradients at the delta-attention inputs changes accuracy to $65.25\pm12.40$% in the matched seven-seed comparison, increasing SD by 50.2%. It also delays a 99% validation threshold on average among the same six seeds that reach it; the 95% threshold is reached earlier on average with input-gradient blocking across all seven seeds. Third, lower delta attention exhibits substantially less extrapolation degradation than lower state attention: 62.60% versus 19.40%, against a 71.06% baseline. Removing its correction reduces accuracy to 22.56%; its advantage over lower state attention also persists under input-gradient blocking. These observations motivate bounded update-level attention as a recurrent learning scaffold, combining reduced seed variation with less severe degradation in a placement where state attention fails.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究循环记忆中的有界 delta 注意力：对未校正的更新提案做因果注意力，再把有界校正写入循环状态；在 TraceRelay 的加法相位循环与并行扫描上以 prefix-supervised modulo-5 训练，比较上层/下层 delta 注意力与状态注意力的长度外推及七种子方差。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽非视觉多模态工作，但其更新级注意力、梯度阻断和长度泛化/种子稳定性分析，可能为 latent 循环推理中状态写入位置与训练监督提供可核查线索。
